critical_load_protection.enforcement_status: ACTIVE - Architecturally enforced, cannot be overridden

capacity_reservation.rationale: High essential service density. 30% capacity reserved for critical loads.
capacity_reservation.enforcement: Reserved capacity is excluded from optimization, monetization, and load-shedding logic

baseline.description: Normal operation with all essential services active

peak.description: Peak demand when all services operate simultaneously

shock.description: Emergency scenario requiring maximum essential service capacity

planning_requirements: Infrastructure MUST reserve 30% capacity for essential services
Essential service loads cannot be shed during peak demand periods
Productive use optimization must operate within remaining capacity only
Emergency scenarios require ability to scale essential capacity to 50%

infrastructure_planning_guidance.investment_recommendation: RECOMMENDED: Prioritize infrastructure deployment in 2 high-confidence zone(s). Coordination patterns are stable and validated, indicating bankable demand.
infrastructure_planning_guidance.capacity_planning_note: Infrastructure capacity must account for productive-use demand patterns, not just household consumption. Social reserve enforced for essential services.

social_reserve_policy.description: 20% capacity reserved for communal productive assets
social_reserve_policy.rationale: Ensures infrastructure serves collective economic activity, not just individual consumption
social_reserve_policy.implementation: Infrastructure design must include capacity for shared assets (mills, pumps, cold storage)

system_invariants: Zero-PII: No personal identifiers in any data or outputs
Temporal Moat: All processing in time-batched windows (no real-time tracking)
Coordination > Identity: System reasons over collective patterns only
Semantic Guard: No surveillance, credit scoring, or individual profiling
ethics_compliance.verification: All outputs are auditable against AGENTS.md system invariants
ethics_compliance.data_governance: Raw signals are never stored or exported. Only aggregated patterns cross institutional boundary.
